footer.aboutTitle: About This Cambridge Entrance Exam Quiz
footer.aboutText: This is a fun Cambridge-style reasoning quiz built around quick logic, number patterns, word clues, probability, and everyday brain teasers. It is for entertainment and self-challenge only. It is not an official University of Cambridge exam, admissions test, IQ test, academic assessment, or educational credential.

landing.quickStartText: Take the fast logic challenge and see if you can beat the 6%.

stageGroups.title: Warm-Up Logic
stageGroups.encouragement: Nice start. The next round adds more pressure with probability, analogies, and tighter patterns.

questions.prompt: Which number comes next: 5, 10, 20, 40, ?
Which word does not belong: Oak, Pine, Rose, Cedar?
If today is Monday, what day will it be in 9 days?
If all Daxes are Lumes, and all Lumes are Varns, what must be true?
Which shape has five sides?
If BLUE becomes CMVF, what does GOLD become?
Which number is divisible by 3: 14, 20, 27, 32?
Five people each shake hands with every other person once. How many handshakes occur?
Which letter comes next: A, D, G, J, ?
A lecture starts at 2:15 and ends at 3:05. How long is it?

stageGroups.title: Brain Teasers
stageGroups.encouragement: Good work. The final admissions round mixes several skills at once, so slow down and read every word.

questions.prompt: Which number is missing: 1, 4, 9, 16, ?
Nora is older than Leo. Leo is older than Mira. Who is youngest?
Which pair matches map : route?
If PAGE becomes QBHF, what does NOTE become?
A bag has 4 green counters and 6 red counters. What is the probability of picking green?
Three pencils cost £6. How much do seven pencils cost?
Library is to book as gallery is to what?
Which number completes: 2, 6, 12, 20, ?
If Sam sits left of Priya, and Priya sits left of Theo, who is in the middle?
A meeting starts at 11:40 and ends at 12:25. How long does it last?

stageGroups.title: Final Admissions Round
stageGroups.encouragement: Final round complete. Your result is ready.

questions.prompt: Which number comes next: 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, ?
A clock shows 6:00. What is the angle between the hands?
If some writers are teachers, and all teachers are readers, what must be true?
Which is larger: three-fifths or one-half?
If three people can pack three boxes in three minutes, how many boxes can six people pack in three minutes?
You flip a fair coin twice. What is the probability of getting two heads?
A cube is painted on all sides and cut into 8 equal cubes. How many small cubes have paint on exactly three faces?
Which number comes next: 3, 6, 11, 18, 27, ?
Which word is closest in meaning to precise?
Three consecutive numbers add up to 99. What is the middle number?
